notes.title: The Levels & Leeks Update
notes.notes:
[p]It’s a beautiful day to celebrate fiber intake in the monastery!

In version 1118, we’re serving you a plate of cold, raw vegetables as well as new levels at a more pleasant temperature. Possibly texture as well, we haven’t tried eating the walls. Yet.

Here’s the full patch notes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added four new levels to chapters 1, 3 and 4! [/p][list][*][p]These levels are also present in Endless Mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added three vegetables to the game: Cabbages, Leeks and Turnips![/p][/*][*][p]Major performance improvements for visual effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to voice chat[/p][/*][*][p]Hopefully 🤞 fixed an issue where certain NPCs would exist on clients but *not* on the server [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Are you looking for more MEAT? We’ll have something pretty beefy for you in the next one. Stay tuned!

Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking can be picked up for $7.99 USD:
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"]
[/url]See you in the monastery,

- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Crashing into view is v.1117 - the Molotovs & Tamed Rats update.
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, my monks![/p][p][/p][p]I recall asking you whether you were feeling quite flame-y enough.[/p][p][/p][p]Well, I hope you weren't, because we've introduced more exciting sources of fires in this one. [/p][p][/p][p]On an additional serious note: [b]we also greatly modified the behavior of rats.[/b]

Yes, we called upon the professional rat tamers that we have connections with and they taught the rats proper theft etiquette.

We heard folks loud and clear on this one - rats were a [i]bit[/i] punishing and we respect the feedback.
[/p][p]Among a host of other taming modifications, rats will now specifically only target items currently held in the player's hand, meaning you should be able to better prepare yourself to respond to their presence accordingly. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are the full patch notes for the [b]Molotovs & Tamed Rats update[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added four new items: [b]Mimic Food, Cross Grenade, Molotovs and the Invulnerability Cross![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Mimic Food behaves like a regular food item but, when picked up, turns into... something else[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the behavior of rats. They're not quite model citizens, but they're much better[/p][/*][*][p]Removed an old unused tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of tweaks and fixes across many levels![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You can grab [b]Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking [/b]for $7.99 USD.   [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][p]See you in the monastery,[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix (v.1115)
notes.notes:
[p]Good afternoon, monks![/p][p][/p][p]We had some reports that some of you were experiencing an issue with the countdown timer starting. Fortunately, we were able to fix that quickly![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the countdown timer would not start upon starting a game round[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get poisoned when entering the larder ☠️[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As always, thank you so much for sending along your feedback and reports.

If you find anything else to report, be sure to let us know![/p][p]

Back to the larder,[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Changelog for ver. 1113: the New Levels Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, little monks!

It's not too big of a list this time aside from the new levels - we're working on cooking something quite big to share with you soon.

In the meantime, [b]here are the notes for version 1113:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Two new levels got added to Chapters 2 & 4! (2 new levels for Chapter 2 + another 2 new levels for Chapter 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Many fixes were implemented for other levels[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where only the server could push things with the broom[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spice falls were not being replicated correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Will O' Wisps would appear to be stuck in place for players other than the host[/p][/*][/list][p]
We'll talk again real soon,[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to v. 1111, a.k.a the GET SOME SPACE update. 🧹
notes.notes:
[p]Hello hello!

I'm back with another round of fun post-launch updates.

This time, WE'VE GOT TOOLS FOR YA.

Were you not feeling enough wind in your little monk sails last time?

Not feeling quite flame-y enough?

Well, that's very specific of you, but I have great news.

You're gonna get a dang broom. You're gonna get a flaming crossbow. And you know what? You're gonna get.. potentially even more sources of fire in this update. Because we care about you and your health.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the full patch notes for the [b]Get Some Space [/b]update:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Fire Crossbow. Y'know, for setting things on fire[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Knockback Broom. Y'know, for knocking things back[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Pack of Candles. Y'know, for flashbanging your foes (the team tells me this is what candles are apparently for)[/p][/*][*][p]Useful level modifications happened[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shadows would be cast from the chat bubbles above players' heads[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where oil would make the host slippery but not other players (😳)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Steam Deck support with new default graphics settings and a new default Steam Input map![/p][/*][*][p]Added AMD FSR3 as an anti-aliasing option! This can be paired with the render scale setting to greatly improve performance on weaker computers[/p][/*][*][p]Added the new tools to all shops[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the tutorial messages for players on the Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where spicefalls wouldn't have their intended spice effect[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with apples and oranges. Again, lol[/p][/*][*][p]Fall damage now takes the player's velocity into consideration[/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]When I grabbed this list from the programmers, I found a scribbled note that just says "use knockback brooms to rocket jump." What on earth did they mean by that??? Hello?[/p][p][/p][p]You can grab [b]Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking [/b]for $7.99 USD![b]
[/b]  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Please sweep responsibly. [/p][p]
See you in the monastery (with [i][b]even more[/b][/i] updates soon),[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: It's v. 1106, the Chant Voice Customization Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi folks!


In our first really fun round of post-launch updates, I'm excited to announce that we have now [b]implemented chant voices[/b] that you can select from.

This is 100% so that you can truly feel in-tune with your monk as you play and absolutely not so you can haunt both your friends and the NPCs.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the full patch notes:[/p][list][*][p]Voice chat has been reworked - you should expect improved audio quality now![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can now change microphones for voice chat [/p][/*][*][p]Players can now customize their chant voice![/p][/*][*][p]There's now a voice chat icon on top of players that are talking[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the hold zones for pies & cheese items on both monks and rats[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where joining a server too late would cause clients to see incorrect spicefall particles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As a reminder, you'll currently find [b]Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD)[/b] 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3139570/Coop_Kaiju_Horror_Cooking/"][/dynamiclink]
Please chant responsibly.
[/p][p]
See you in the monastery (with even more updates soon),[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Resolution for Crashing Issues in Newest Game Version: vers. 1104
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!

We were recently made aware of crashes affecting folks starting the game after we tried to rectify a different issue involving crashes when enabling Windowed mode. [b]We have since addressed both issues.[/b]

If you're still crashing from an earlier save, you should be able to delete that save folder and continue playing.

Please let us know if anything else comes up and we'll hop to it!


As a reminder,[b] you'll currently find Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD)[/b] [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3139570/announcements/detail/539986220231435188"][/dynamiclink]
Thanks again for all of your prompt feedback & reports - keep em coming.

We'll be back with you soon to start chatting about all the updates we've got in store.

Let's just say, I hope you REALLY like chanting.[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Changelog for Release: ver. 1103
notes.notes:
[p]Happy launch day, monks!

[b]To celebrate launch, you'll find Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking on sale for 40% off ($4.79 USD)[/b]
[dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3139570/announcements/detail/539986220231435188"][/dynamiclink]
Below, you'll also find our first release changelog, officially bridging the playtest to our launch.

We want to thank you all so much for playing with us over the last week as well as leaving us all of your reports + feedback. It's been immensely helpful, and the team has been actively working to address your reports.
[b]
Here are the notes for version 1103:[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Visual effects have been optimized[/p][/*][*][p]Reducing the graphics settings should now hide some smaller effects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rats would not drop their items upon death (they were dedicated)[/p][/*][*][p]All item vendors in the Monastery had their inventories tweaked[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dynamic difficulty system that adjusts certain parameters of the game according to the amount of players in the match[/p][/*][*][p]Improved controller support for the player kick screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain items would have their names displayed with ALL CAPS[/p][/*][*][p]Going back to the Monastery after a successful match will now erase the inventory of all players (sorry!!)[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed an issue where certain visual effects would vanish from the player's screen if the player moved their camera fast enough[/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual effect for when the Minotaur charges into a wall (it's very good and funny)[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the knockback of the Wooden Cross on Evil Spirits[/p][/*][*][p]Plenty of text changes[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Credits screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with Pascal's beard (sorry bud)[/p][/*][*][p]Improved item throwing[/p][/*][*][p]The game's timer will now start with exactly 10 minutes[/p][/*][*][p]After dying, NPCs will now fade out faster[/p][/*][*][p]Chanting had its stamina consumption halved[/p][/*][*][p]The Rolling Pin's cooldown has been reduced to match the Cleaver's cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]The Big Rock now deals a lot more damage, can now be used to crush ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Upon satisfying the Kaiju, the HUD's timer will correctly display one minute left for players to bring all treasure to the lift[/p][/*][*][p]The Minotaur can no longer steer during a charge after hitting at least one character[/p][/*][*][p]Also, the Minotaur can only deal damage after 1 second has passed since it started charging.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to anonymize player names (we're hoping this makes footage & streaming feel much more accessible!)[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking twice on the same lobby in the lobby selection panel should no longer display the "Stuff's on fire!" message.[/p][/*][*][p]The Crossbow is no longer a large item[/p][/*][*][p]If all players die after the Kaiju has been fed, the victory screen shows up instantly instead of only after 1 minute[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Seasoning Portals could have incorrect effects[/p][/*][*][p]Successfully feeding the Kaiju will now display a message on the Event Log on the upper right corner of the screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We'd love to emphasize again: If you still experience crashes after updating, [b]please try running the game with DirectX 11![/b]

Have a great week,[/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: ver. 1037
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all!

It's been a blast seeing you all have fun with the Co-op Kaiju Horror Cooking Playtest this past week.

Our team would love to make known our recent batch of notes for [b]ver. 1037[/b]![/p][p]
Let's dive right in.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed various dialogue issues & bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient sounds have been reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Monastery fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed a few items and modified some reminders[/p][/*][*][p]Various tweaks to the player burning VFX[/p][p](↑ being on fire is no longer blinding 🧯👁️)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing the Back button on a gamepad would cause a developer panel to show up[/p][/*][*][p]HUD updates[/p][/*][*][p]Restored collision to the voice tubes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with lobby player counts[/p][/*][*][p]Added more options to the options menu, including: inverted controls, FOV sliders, screen resolutions and other adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the range of Ghoul attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Players should no longer clip through elevators[/p][/*][*][p]Rats are easier to hit now (go get your revenge)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing Tab could lock a player in place & focus an invisible HUD element[/p][/*][*][p](We're hoping 🤞) we fixed an issue where changing screen resolutions would cause the game to crash[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where player customization would sometimes not save correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Many, many level fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where lobbies wouldn't show up on the list. (This has ALSO fixed another issue where lobby inviting wouldn't work!)[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby data should be more accurate now[/p][/*][*][p]Players who had toggled 'full screen' and were crashing should no longer crash[/p][/*][*][p]Steam will now ask players to choose between DX12 and DX11! (Try DX11 if you're having crash issues)[/p][/*][*][p]Game should no longer crash upon beating a chapter[/p][/*][*][p]VOIP issues should now be fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Added a post-chapter victory panel for when players complete an entire chapter,[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer duplicate items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would not respawn correctly after the end of a match,[/p][/*][*][p]Added snapping to the mangonel / catapult[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Additionally, [b]achievements are now in![/b] This won't be noticeable for playtesting purposes (sorry!!) but they'll be ready for launch in one week.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We're also investigating:[/b][/p][list][*][p]An issue where the player will hold their entire inventory at once after becoming visible again,[/p][/*][*][p]Solutions to reported performance issues. We've set up test environments on older hardware to better profile the causes of these issues,[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b].. as well as planning for the near future:[/b][/p][list][*][p]More Lobby Admin QoL adjustments,[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support,[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p] If you still experience crashes after updating, please try running the game with DirectX 11!

As always, thank you folks so much for sending along your feedback and reports.

If you find anything else to report, be sure to let us know!

See you in the monastery, [/p][p]
- Christa @ Strange Scaffold[/p]
